text:
Morgan: Quick sync - background workers still using org API keys. We should tighten scope.
Riya: Agreed. My take: project-scoped short-lived tokens via exchange endpoint.
Sam: How do we represent roles? role@proj or global role + proj claim? Tracing prefers stable role ids.
Tess: Lean global role + explicit proj claim in JWT. Token signed by broker, TTL 10-60m.
Morgan: Auditing concern 12 we need offline verification for forensic logs.
Riya: Publish JWKS and include kid in logs; also index exchange events.
Sam: Cross-project pipelines: do we mint multi-proj tokens? Blast radius worries me.
Tess: Prefer single-proj tokens and a lightweight sidecar that swaps tokens per request; cache until expiry.
sec-bot: policy-bot: Draft policy + threat model posted: https://rdrw.co/rfc/service-scope :page_facing_up:
Morgan: Rollout: canary internal jobs first, fallback to org-key behind rate limits.
Tess: I'll author the follow-up RFC with token shape, signing/rotation, broker auth, SDK examples, migration playbook. @Sam can you own canary scripts?
Sam: Yup, will spin up a sidecar PoC and canary automation.
Morgan: Thanks all. I'll paste tickets into the RFC thread later. :thumbsup:
